# shell

**In one sentence:** the glue for the project window (the "shell" view): binds its buttons to actions, repaints it, and switches its tabs.

## What's inside
| File | What it does |
|---|---|
| `events.js` | `bindEvents()` — connects the project window's controls: Pipeline / Metadata tabs, token input, Refresh, step-list toolbar, Run, Cancel, Open input / output, Auto-scroll. |
| `render.js` | `render()` — repaints the whole window by calling `renderMetadata`, `renderSteps`, and `renderJob` in that order. |
| `tabs.js` | `setActiveTab(name)` — toggles the `.nf-tab` buttons and `.tab-pane` panels. |
| `shell.css` | Page-level layout: full-window `#app`, panels, tabs, metadata grid, force row, and the run-status pill colours driven by `#app[data-job-status]`. |

## How it works
- `core/app.js` calls `bindEvents()` once at start-up.
- Any code that changes `state` calls `render()`; it is cheap enough to run on every 800 ms job poll.
- The run-status colours change through the `data-job-status` attribute set by `setShellStatus` in `core/dom.js`, not by swapping `nf-runstatus--*` classes.

## Who uses it
- `core/app.js` (`bindEvents`, `render`), `project/controller.js` and `job/controller.js` (`render`).
- Tests: none import these files directly; they run through `project_controller.test.js` and `job_view.test.js`.
